notes.problem: No tray visible; grey-green mid-tone floor fills the bottom 40 percent.
notes.fix: Lower and closer so the tray walls and lip run off the edges; pull fog out of the floor.

notes.problem: No tray in frame; fin stacks and DIMM slabs float over teal-grey fog; bottom third dead.
notes.fix: Pull back and up so the tray walls, pan and lip enclose both sinks; seat it on the dark tile in the pool.

notes.problem: Copper sinks fill the width, no tray wall shows, lower third dead.
notes.fix: Pull the camera back and lower it so one full tray with walls and both sinks sits in the pool, shadow into the bottom third.

notes.problem: Flat top-down plate reads as a keyboard; casts short and even.
notes.fix: Rake the key low so trays throw long casts; carrier bleeds; eight cyan trays in a tighter pool.

notes.problem: Carrier touches the dek; grid reads as a keyboard.
notes.fix: Drop the carrier 40 px and darken it.

notes.problem: 64-tray wall straight on reads as a flat chart; carrier tight under the dek.
notes.fix: Rake the view and drop the carrier 120 px so tray depth and casts show.

notes.problem: Joined core a hard-edged rectangle reads as a plug.
notes.fix: A curved hourglass stalk with a continuous core.

notes.problem: Join is a rectangular plug; bundles shrink against frame 4.
notes.fix: A continuous hourglass neck; keep the bundles at frame 4's height.

notes.problem: Reuses frame 4's vesicle and bilayer from nearly the same camera.
notes.fix: Crop tight on the fusion site so joined interiors and four SNAREs fill a third to half the frame.

notes.problem: Crate shadow face crushed black, plywood banding, one leaning slab, flat whips; reads as a nightstand.
notes.fix: Open a lifted row with a lit plenum edge and whips rising toward the crate; fill the right face to L* 8 to 12; fine grain.

notes.problem: Wooden crate reads as a nightstand at feed size; warm wood outside the steel and cyan vocabulary; cables trail into a dead lower left.
notes.fix: Model Horizon as the deck's own rack, half populated, a few trays sliding in, empty slots dark.

notes.problem: Uniform mid-grey field; eight raised cells tiny; casts barely darker.
notes.fix: Lower key elevation for long casts; field albedo near black; bleed the field.

notes.problem: Eight raised cells read as a dotted line; cast reads as a smear.
notes.fix: Raise the eight cells three times higher with lit chamfers and crisp short casts; darken the field.

notes.problem: Pool left of the tower; rails read as a ladder; base runs into the footer band.
notes.fix: Centre the pool under the tower; base above y 900.
